# throwaway tsx script (not checked in) equivalent to:
#   import { encodeFreePlaySize, decodeFreePlaySize } from '../src/sim/freePlayTopologies';
#   function dump(type, size) {
#     const raw = encodeFreePlaySize(size);
#     const decoded = decodeFreePlaySize(type, raw);
#     const reencoded = encodeFreePlaySize(decoded);
#     console.log(`SIZE ${raw} => ${reencoded} :: ${JSON.stringify(decoded)}`);
#   }
#   dump('single-dc', { brokersPerZone: [10], partitions: 1, replicationFactor: 1,
#     extraTopics: [{ name: 'wal', partitions: 4, replicationFactor: 3, minInSyncReplicas: 1, cleanupPolicy: 'delete', disklessEnable: true }] });

#   // then primaryDiskless:true alone, then + disklessTiming:{commitIntervalMs:250,uploadMs:600},
#   // then disklessTiming:{uploadMs:900} with no primaryDiskless (an extra topic
#   // carries the diskless flag instead) - see mapping/size_test.go's matching
#   // TestBuildSize cases for the exact FreePlaySize shape of each line, in order.

# 2026-09-24 (Task C): mcpserver/shape.go gained shape.disklessTiming, exposing
# the SAME session-wide tail-index-17 timing that mapping/size.go's
# disklessTail already encoded (via the new exported mapping.EncodeDisklessTail
# helper both packages now call). No new SIZE lines were generated for it - the
# two "primary diskless flag with timing" / "diskless timing only, upload side"
# lines above already pin the exact slugs mcpserver/shape_test.go's new
# TestShapeDocExamples cases assert, for the same broker/topic shapes. Task C
# also looked at producer/consumer-group `client.rack` (KIP-1163 draft) parity
# per task-B-report.md - neither mapping/size.go nor mcpserver/shape.go encode
# producers or consumer groups at all (no size-slug tail index 1/2 codec exists
# in this Go tool), so there was nothing to mirror it onto; see the "What is
# NOT represented" note in docs/mapping.md.
